title: DLMF 26.13 Permutations: Cycle Notation: \mathfrak{S}_{n} denotes the set of permutations of \{1,2,\ldots,n\} .
summary: DLMF 26.13 Permutations: Cycle Notation: \mathfrak{S}_{n} denotes the set of permutations of \{1,2,\ldots,n\} .
body: NIST DLMF section 26.13 (Permutations: Cycle Notation) says: "\mathfrak{S}_{n} denotes the set of permutations of \{1,2,\ldots,n\} . \sigma\in\mathfrak{S}_{n} is a one-to-one and onto mapping from \{1,2,\ldots,n\} to itself. An explicit representation of \sigma can be given by the 2\times n matrix: In cycle notation, the elements in each cycle are put inside parentheses, ordered so that \sigma(j) immediately follows j or, if j is the last listed element of the cycle, then \sigma(j) is the first element of the cycle. The permutation is {\left(1,3,2,5,7\right)}{\left(4\right)}{\left(6,8\right)} in cycle notation. Cycles of length one are fixed points . They are often dropped from the cycle notation. In consequence, ( 26.13.2 ) can also be written as {\left(1,3,2,5,7\right)}{\left(6,8\right)} . An element of \mathfrak{S}_{n} with a_{1} fixed points, a_{2} cycles of length 2,\ldots,a_{n} cycles of length n , where n=a_{1}+2a_{2}+\cdots+na_{n} , is said to have cycle type {\left(a_{1},a_{2},\ldots,a_{n}\right)} . The number of elements of \mathfrak{S}_{n} with cycle type {\left(a_{1},a_{2},\ldots,a_{n}\right)} is given by ( 26.4.7 )." Equation 26.13.1 on the page has alt text "\begin{bmatrix}1&2&3&\cdots&n\\ \sigma(1)&\sigma(2)&\sigma(3)&\cdots&\sigma(n)\end{bmatrix}.". Equation 26.13.2 on the page has alt text "\begin{bmatrix}1&2&3&4&5&6&7&8\\ 3&5&2&4&7&8&1&6\end{bmatrix}". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
